collection.description: After a frightening accident, a fisher cannot face the sea.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: After a frightening accident, a fisher cannot face the sea.

choices.label: Take gradual supervised steps toward returning.
Move into net-making or coastal work.
Force a return too soon and suffer a setback.
Discover a new interest in farming.

outcome.name: Ending
outcome.text: The decision may restore confidence, create a new apprenticeship, change profession or duties, or expose a preventable error. An honest admission can still bring accountability; concealment may appear to work initially but create a delayed callback.
